result.summary: The food delivery home screen has several visual layout problems: truncated restaurant names, a cut-off category chip, a missing Orders tab icon, and a popular restaurant card whose name/details are cropped at the bottom.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card title to wrap to two lines, shrink the type, or give the horizontal list enough width so names are fully visible.

issues.description: The Orders item in the bottom tab bar has a label but no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon so all tabs are visually consistent and easier to tap.

issues.description: The second Popular restaurant card is clipped by the bottom of the screen, so the restaurant name and metadata are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so cards fully clear the tab bar, or ensure the list scrolls enough to reveal the full card.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is cut off on the right edge, and the next chip is only a sliver.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade so chips aren't abruptly clipped, and make the horizontal scroll affordance clearer.
